# Mowzie’s Mobs

<div class="mod-page-icon" markdown="1">

![](../../assets/mods/mowziesmobs.png)

</div>

Ruins, creatures and bosses such as the Ferrous Wroughtnaut, Frostmaw and Umvuthi.

Installed build `1.8.2`. [Browse all mods](index.md).

## Effects

| In-game name | ID | In-game description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Eclipse | `mowziesmobs:eclipsed` | Prevents all other status effects while active. |
| Fragility | `mowziesmobs:fragility` | Increases damage taken. |
| Frozen | `mowziesmobs:frozen` | Prevents all actions for a short duration. Fire damage will remove the effect early. |
| Geomancy | `mowziesmobs:geomancy` | Allows you to command the power of the earth. |
| Poison Resistance | `mowziesmobs:poison_resist` | Prevents the Poison status effect. |
| Sun's Blessing | `mowziesmobs:suns_blessing` | Allows you to command the power of the sun. |
| Sunblock | `mowziesmobs:sunblock` | A small boost to regeneration and damage resistance. |
